description: Strength for Today, Year 3. Scripture-grounded doctrinal revision drafts; not independently edited or approved for publication.

entries.title: Strength for Today — Return to the Word
entries.reflection: Revival is not noise or excitement alone; it calls for renewed love, prayer, repentance, and obedience before God. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Pray over the passage before acting.
entries.prayer: Father, revive my devotion to You when plans change; help me choose truthful words. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Revival is not noise or excitement alone; it calls for renewed love, prayer, repentance, and obedience before God. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Pray over the passage before acting.
topics.prayer: Father, revive my devotion to You when plans change; help me choose truthful words. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Sanctification is God's gracious work, not an excuse for careless living or self-righteousness. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Ask how the passage corrects your assumptions.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me holiness in daily conduct when plans change; help me act with patience. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: When answers delay, continue to pray and fulfil the responsibilities before you. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Choose a quiet act of obedience.
topics.prayer: Father, steady my hope in Your promises when plans change; help me practise what Scripture teaches. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Do not let public prayer replace secret devotion and obedient living. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Take responsibility for the next faithful step.
topics.prayer: Father, train me to pray with perseverance when plans change; help me pray before reacting. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Christ's death and resurrection are central to the gospel, not our personal achievements. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Let this teaching shape the words you use.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance when plans change; help me remember Your faithfulness. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Trust the Lord enough to tell the truth even when deception looks convenient. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider whom you can serve today.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith when plans change; help me make time for Your Word. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit empowers believers to witness for Christ and glorify Him. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Examine whether your motives agree with Scripture.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with courage to witness when plans change; help me give thanks in every duty. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The aim of evangelism is to point people to Christ, not to win an argument. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Recall the Lord's faithfulness as you decide.
topics.prayer: Father, make my gospel witness compassionate when plans change; help me seek wise counsel. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Do not spread a rumour when you could seek understanding and peace. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Bring the matter before God in humble prayer.
topics.prayer: Father, help me love others in truth when plans change; help me forgive rather than resent. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Obey what Scripture teaches even when no one is watching. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Respond with the patience Christ teaches.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Your Word when plans change; help me keep my commitments. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Wisdom listens carefully and resists hasty judgment. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Seek to repair what has been damaged.
topics.prayer: Father, grant me discernment from Scripture when plans change; help me speak with gentleness. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Encourage believers to remain steadfast rather than stirring fear with speculation. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Choose truth rather than convenience.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me watchful for Christ when plans change; help me resist an easy compromise. In Jesus' name, amen.

entries.title: Strength for Today — A Heart Set Apart
entries.reflection: Do not excuse a dishonest action because it seems small; a clean conscience honours Christ. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Put the lesson into practice without delay.
entries.prayer: Father, teach me holiness in daily conduct in family conversations; help me act with patience. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Do not mistake a crowded meeting for a revived heart. Ask whether Scripture is shaping your private choices. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Show compassion while holding to the truth.
topics.prayer: Father, revive my devotion to You in family conversations; help me choose truthful words. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Do not excuse a dishonest action because it seems small; a clean conscience honours Christ. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Put the lesson into practice without delay.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me holiness in daily conduct in family conversations; help me act with patience. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: Bring your anxious thoughts to the Lord and support someone else with practical care. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Seek counsel rooted in Scripture.
topics.prayer: Father, steady my hope in Your promises in family conversations; help me practise what Scripture teaches. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Intercede for family, the church, and the spread of the gospel with humility. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Turn from any compromise the passage exposes.
topics.prayer: Father, train me to pray with perseverance in family conversations; help me pray before reacting. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Speak of judgment with reverence and present the mercy offered in Christ. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Practice gratitude alongside faithful action.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance in family conversations; help me remember Your faithfulness. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faith rests on God's truth and is expressed through obedience, not mere positive thinking. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Make room for someone else's burden.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith in family conversations; help me make time for Your Word. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Spiritual gifts must be exercised with love, truth, and biblical discernment. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Refuse pride and cultivate a teachable spirit.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with courage to witness in family conversations; help me give thanks in every duty. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: A faithful witness explains repentance, faith, and the hope of salvation. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Let the hope of Christ guide your priorities.
topics.prayer: Father, make my gospel witness compassionate in family conversations; help me seek wise counsel. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Love corrects gently and refuses to celebrate wrongdoing. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Serve faithfully even when unnoticed.
topics.prayer: Father, help me love others in truth in family conversations; help me forgive rather than resent. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Do not replace careful Bible study with an attractive slogan. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Listen carefully before speaking.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Your Word in family conversations; help me keep my commitments. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Recognise the limits of your knowledge and remain willing to learn. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Use the opportunity to point to Christ.
topics.prayer: Father, grant me discernment from Scripture in family conversations; help me speak with gentleness. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Christ calls believers to watchfulness, repentance, and faithful service as they await His return. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Remember that grace calls for obedience.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me watchful for Christ in family conversations; help me resist an easy compromise. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith when I face criticism; help me make time for Your Word. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

topics.prayer: Father, help me love others in truth when I face criticism; help me forgive rather than resent. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Your Word when I face criticism; help me keep my commitments. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.prayer: Father, keep me watchful for Christ when I face criticism; help me resist an easy compromise. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;

entries.prayer: Father, help me love others in truth as I examine my motives; help me show kindness in action. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Revival is not noise or excitement alone; it calls for renewed love, prayer, repentance, and obedience before God. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Listen carefully before speaking.
topics.prayer: Father, revive my devotion to You as I examine my motives; help me seek wise counsel. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Sanctification is God's gracious work, not an excuse for careless living or self-righteousness. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Use the opportunity to point to Christ.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me holiness in daily conduct as I examine my motives; help me forgive rather than resent. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: When answers delay, continue to pray and fulfil the responsibilities before you. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Remember that grace calls for obedience.
topics.prayer: Father, steady my hope in Your promises as I examine my motives; help me keep my commitments. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Do not let public prayer replace secret devotion and obedient living. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Consider the needs of the church and your neighbours.
topics.prayer: Father, train me to pray with perseverance as I examine my motives; help me speak with gentleness. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Christ's death and resurrection are central to the gospel, not our personal achievements. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Act thoughtfully instead of reacting in haste.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance as I examine my motives; help me resist an easy compromise. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Trust the Lord enough to tell the truth even when deception looks convenient. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Hold fast to the truth with gentleness.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith as I examine my motives; help me reconcile where possible. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit empowers believers to witness for Christ and glorify Him. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Keep your commitments as an act of worship.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with courage to witness as I examine my motives; help me listen before answering. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The aim of evangelism is to point people to Christ, not to win an argument. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Let love and holiness mark your response.
topics.prayer: Father, make my gospel witness compassionate as I examine my motives; help me serve without pride. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Do not spread a rumour when you could seek understanding and peace. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Trust God rather than forcing an outcome.
topics.prayer: Father, help me love others in truth as I examine my motives; help me show kindness in action. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Obey what Scripture teaches even when no one is watching. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Examine your conscience under the light of Scripture.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Your Word as I examine my motives; help me take responsibility. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Wisdom listens carefully and resists hasty judgment. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Pray over the passage before acting.
topics.prayer: Father, grant me discernment from Scripture as I examine my motives; help me care for someone in need. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

topics.prayer: Father, keep me watchful for Christ as I examine my motives; help me respond with humility. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The aim of evangelism is to point people to Christ, not to win an argument. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Listen carefully before speaking.
topics.prayer: Father, make my gospel witness compassionate as I consider my priorities; help me practise what Scripture teaches. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Do not spread a rumour when you could seek understanding and peace. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Use the opportunity to point to Christ.
topics.prayer: Father, help me love others in truth as I consider my priorities; help me pray before reacting. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Obey what Scripture teaches even when no one is watching. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Remember that grace calls for obedience.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Your Word as I consider my priorities; help me remember Your faithfulness. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Wisdom listens carefully and resists hasty judgment. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider the needs of the church and your neighbours.
topics.prayer: Father, grant me discernment from Scripture as I consider my priorities; help me make time for Your Word. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Encourage believers to remain steadfast rather than stirring fear with speculation. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Act thoughtfully instead of reacting in haste.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me watchful for Christ as I consider my priorities; help me give thanks in every duty. In Jesus' name, amen.

entries.title: Strength for Today — Power to Witness
entries.reflection: Spiritual gifts must be exercised with love, truth, and biblical discernment. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Ask how the passage corrects your assumptions.
entries.prayer: Father, fill me with courage to witness when I need courage; help me act with patience. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Do not mistake a crowded meeting for a revived heart. Ask whether Scripture is shaping your private choices. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Hold fast to the truth with gentleness.
topics.prayer: Father, revive my devotion to You when I need courage; help me serve without pride. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Do not excuse a dishonest action because it seems small; a clean conscience honours Christ. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Keep your commitments as an act of worship.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me holiness in daily conduct when I need courage; help me show kindness in action. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: Bring your anxious thoughts to the Lord and support someone else with practical care. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Let love and holiness mark your response.
topics.prayer: Father, steady my hope in Your promises when I need courage; help me take responsibility. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Intercede for family, the church, and the spread of the gospel with humility. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Trust God rather than forcing an outcome.
topics.prayer: Father, train me to pray with perseverance when I need courage; help me care for someone in need. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Speak of judgment with reverence and present the mercy offered in Christ. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Examine your conscience under the light of Scripture.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance when I need courage; help me respond with humility. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faith rests on God's truth and is expressed through obedience, not mere positive thinking. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Pray over the passage before acting.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith when I need courage; help me choose truthful words. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Spiritual gifts must be exercised with love, truth, and biblical discernment. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Ask how the passage corrects your assumptions.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with courage to witness when I need courage; help me act with patience. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: A faithful witness explains repentance, faith, and the hope of salvation. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Choose a quiet act of obedience.
topics.prayer: Father, make my gospel witness compassionate when I need courage; help me practise what Scripture teaches. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Love corrects gently and refuses to celebrate wrongdoing. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Take responsibility for the next faithful step.
topics.prayer: Father, help me love others in truth when I need courage; help me pray before reacting. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Do not replace careful Bible study with an attractive slogan. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Let this teaching shape the words you use.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Your Word when I need courage; help me remember Your faithfulness. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Recognise the limits of your knowledge and remain willing to learn. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Consider whom you can serve today.
topics.prayer: Father, grant me discernment from Scripture when I need courage; help me make time for Your Word. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Christ calls believers to watchfulness, repentance, and faithful service as they await His return. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Examine whether your motives agree with Scripture.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me watchful for Christ when I need courage; help me give thanks in every duty. In Jesus' name, amen.
